Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner imposed an incorrect normalization rule (using only USA release dates and even choosing the latest USA date as “canonical”) and asserted without verification that Xenoa’s USA release was in 2013. The task simply asks which film was released earlier overall, for which the earliest worldwide theatrical dates should be compared (Xenoa in 2007 vs. Divorce Invitation in 2012/2013). This misframing could directly lead to the wrong conclusion.
